case_chat.qualification: The first answer compared A/B correctly but its topic label was DECISION, not COMPARISON.

final_ui_chat.fresh_question: Why was B recommended even though A costs less?
final_ui_chat.answer: Only B was eligible in the original selection snapshot: cost 6 synthetic units, predicted arrival approximately 9.1 min. In final validation, A cost 3 but was rejected because inventory validity had expired at admission. Budget: 8; deadline: 20 min on the same case timeline. Recorded evidence, not dispatch or delivery. Original timing snapshot at approximately 0.1 min: A available at 0 min, base queue 7 min, travel 8 min; B available at 0 min, base queue 0 min, travel 9 min. Inventory expires at 6 min; delivery deadline 20 min; offer expires at 30 min. Separate final validation: A rejected at approximately 7.15 min, B admitted at approximately 0.15 min. Handoff here means simulated admission after availability and queue waiting, not a physical carrier transfer. Base queue durations do not include additional queue-change events. All times use the same case timeline; these historical snapshots do not prove a shipment.
final_ui_chat.ledger_correspondence: Matched original UI question, answer, profile and citations on readonly review.
